entities.summary: Ryan Ashley Robertson is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Sacramento Kings in the second round of the 1999 NBA draft. He played college basketball for the Kansas Jayhawks under coach Roy Williams. He scored a career high 31 points in a second round loss to Kentucky in the 1999 NCAA Tournament.
